{{Quote|Turn Coruscant inside-out and make it a jail where the inmates are in control...|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Masquerade" />}}
'''Axxila''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Geography==
{{Quote|Axxila reminded me too much of Imperial Center, as if it the true reflection of Imperial Center in a mirror.|[[Winter Celchu|Winter]]|<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Mandatory Retirement">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Mandatory Retirement]]''</ref>}}
Axxila was an [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]], often described as "[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], but inside-out".<ref name="Masquerade" /> It was located at the intersection of the [[Celanon Spur/Legends|Celanon Spur]]<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] of industrial worlds that also contained [[Edusa]] and [[Vandyne]].<ref name="Hb1">[[Star Wars Handbook 1: X-Wing Rogue Squadron|''Star Wars Handbook'' 1: ''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'']]</ref> The Axxila system was known as a notable [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] system.<ref name="TEA" />

The system was home to the [[Axxila antipirate fleet]].<ref name="TNEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|People of Axxila, I am Admiral Krennel of the ''Reckoning''. You harbor traitors to the Empire. You are scum who have long festered without proper discipline. Give me the traitors and I will refrain from visiting upon you the retribution you most assuredly deserve.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Delak Krennel]]|<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron 30">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 30|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 30]]</ref>}}
During the [[Jedi Civil War]], Axxila was the site of a [[Battle of Axxila|battle]] won by the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Axxila.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The streets of Axxila.]]

It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]], the last commanding officer of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]].<ref name="TNEGtC" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Axxila was part of the [[Ciutric Hegemony]]. When the Hegemony, along with Axxila, joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], many Axxilan, known as the [[Free Axxilans]], fled the planet and relocated to the planet [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

Following the end of the Clone Wars, many [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist]] forces retreated to the neighboring [[Ciutric sector/Legends|Ciutric sector]]. The [[Tenth Army|Crimson Dagger Command]] was relocated to Axxila in order to launch a [[Ciutric Offensive|reconquest campaign]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> Several months after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Ysanne Isard]] sent Admiral [[Delak Krennel]] to [[Undercover operation on Axxila|attack]] the planet in order to prevent [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] from giving [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Krennel wiped out many civilians in the strike.<ref name="Masquerade" /> Krennel later took control of the Ciutric Hegemony, excepting Axxila.<ref name="TEA" />

Axxila was conquered by the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] after their acquisition of [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]] in [[25 ABY]], though it was not attacked outright. In [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the world was used by the invaders as a platform for a string of assaults on [[Pedd Four|Pedd 4]], [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]], [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Feriae Junction]] and [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. It remained under Yuuzhan Vong control until the end of the war in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]]. Located in [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] space during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], Axxila was later a member state of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], situated near the edge of [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Empire-in-exile]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Axxila first appeared in the [[1998]] comic ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Masquerade]]'' from the comic book series ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron]]'' published by [[Dark Horse Comics]].<ref name="Masquerade" />
